gaps: P0: no candidates; P2: nothing usable (#7 is an 18th-century reprint of the 1572 four-city plate)
notes: #5 and #3 are the same Braun and Hogenberg plate (#5 a 1635 reissue, cleaner scan; #3 has a library stamp and ink number in the sea). The plate’s first volume is uncertain to me (1572 per BnF, about 1574 per a dealer), hence label “1570s”; the four-city plate #1/#2 (Cagliari, Malta, Rhodes, Famagusta) is vol. 1, 1572, but Cagliari is only a quarter of it. #14 was published April 1927; the photo may be a few years older. #9 (1845 street view under the Castello bastion) is an alternative to #8. #15 (2016) shows mostly modern blocks; #18 (2012) is a hazy aerial.
